evidence_signal: The European Commission published automotive-sector guidance for implementing Data Act vehicle-data access rules, covering OEMs, suppliers, aftermarket service providers, and insurers.
supports: vehicle data accessは制度上の論点になっており、supplierもstakeholderとして含まれる。
limits: EPS/SbWサプライヤが特定DTC/DID、整備履歴、交換結果へ使えるとは言えない。
confidence: High for policy relevance / Low for EPS access proof

source_name: Auto Care vehicle data access issue
evidence_signal: Auto Care argues modern vehicle maintenance and repair data is increasingly transmitted wirelessly to manufacturers, who can gate access and cost.
supports: remote data accessはOEM gatekeeping問題になっており、第三者やサプライヤ単独利用は自明ではない。
limits: advocacy sourceであり、EPS supplier固有の契約実態ではない。

evidence_signal: GM Fleet offers OnStar API plans for fleet vehicle data, DTCs, comprehensive diagnostic data, and approved third-party providers under terms.
supports: OEM API経由でfleet vehicle health / DTC dataへ触れる市場インフラはある。
limits: approved provider / terms / plan依存で、EPS固有DIDやservice outcomeは見えない。
confidence: High for API existence / Low for supplier freedom

evidence_signal: Smartcar shows DTC, system status, and odometer APIs using user authorization through Smartcar Connect.
supports: DTCやvehicle healthはAPI化されており、service providersが使える可能性がある。
limits: user authorizationとbrand/API範囲に依存し、EPS supplier internal signalsやrepair outcomeは範囲外。

evidence_signal: High Mobility exposes diagnostics, maintenance, dashboard lights, tire pressure, odometer, and brand-specific scopes/update frequencies.
supports: vehicle data APIは存在するが、scopeとfrequencyがブランド依存であることが見える。
limits: steering/EPS固有DID、freeze frame、交換結果は公開項目として目立たない。

evidence_signal: ZF describes manufacturer cloud to ZF cloud data exchange using anonymous data from ZF systems, with ZF responsible for data interfaces.
supports: Tier-1 supplierがOEM cloud連携でfield health analyticsを行う公開例として強い。
limits: 特定fleetに一般外販できるとは限らず、OEM partnership前提。
confidence: High for supplier pathway / Medium for generalizability

evidence_signal: Bosch cloud diagnostics provides fault descriptions, error codes, risk/criticality assessment, recommended next steps, grouping, and component localization.
supports: DTCを運行・整備判断へ変換する一般価値は既存playerが既に強く扱う。
limits: EPS/SbW固有のassist stateやSbW degraded stateまでは公開説明から不明。

evidence_signal: International provides fault code reporting, severity ratings, action plans, parts visibility, service center mapping, and API connections into fleet platforms.
supports: fleet向けremote diagnosticsはrepair priority、parts、service routingまで既に統合している。
limits: 操舵系固有のdomain triageは見えないが、一般層の差分は薄い。

evidence_signal: Geotab says modern vehicles produce thousands of fault codes and remote diagnostics helps understand faults and prioritize repairs with health reports, action plans, and alerts.
supports: raw DTCだけでは粗いが、そこを解釈しpriority化する既存platformがある。
confidence: High for raw-DTC insufficiency and counter-signal

evidence_signal: Volvo monitors engine, I-Shift, and aftertreatment to avoid unexpected downtime and claims diagnostic-time reduction.
supports: OEM uptime networkが既に診断時間短縮を提供しており、fleet側の購買導線は確立済み。
limits: steering/chassisは主対象として出ない。

evidence_signal: OnStar plans include diagnostic trouble codes and comprehensive diagnostic data, and OnStar Canada describes high-severity DTC notifications with corrective action.
supports: DTC通知とcorrective actionはOEM/API側で既に商品化されている。
limits: steering/EPS固有判断やservice outcome loopは不明。

evidence_signal: ASAM SOVD provides a uniform API for diagnostic content across HPCs, applications, classic ECUs, remote/proximity/in-vehicle diagnostics, fault information, data access, and updates.
supports: 次世代診断ではremote/proximity/in-vehicle diagnosticsの標準化が進み、汎用API層は標準/ツール領域に寄る。
limits: EPSサプライヤ価値はplatformではなく、診断contentの意味づけに限定される。
